title: Where the jobs are: product, agency, consultancy, freelance and abroad

videos.script: There is more than one kind of place that hires juniors, and they are not interchangeable. {{doors}} A company that sells its own product teaches you one system in depth. An agency or a consultancy teaches you many, quickly, on somebody else's deadline. A bank or a hospital with an IT department teaches you to keep a business running. {{kinds}} Then there is working for yourself, and working for a company in another country. Both are possible from Brazil, and both have a catch for somebody on their first job. {{catch}} This lesson sets out the five doors, what each one teaches, and which ones to knock on first.
